Hero Dark block brief

Use this guide before choosing an example.

Library Metadata (Guide)

Title

Authoring guide

Description

Structure, properties & options

Table structure

Use Hero Dark for the default layout. Use Hero Dark (Split) and two-column named rows for split layouts: property name in the first cell, content in the second.

Authoring properties

  • Heading: Use H1, H2 or H3 as appropriate. In a split hero, put it in the Heading row.

  • Eyebrow: Optional short context. Use an Eyebrow row in the split layout.

  • Content: Supporting paragraphs and standalone CTA paragraphs. Use the Content row for a split hero.

  • Image: Use a real image with alternative text. The split Image row supplies the media beside the copy; the default layout places media below.

  • CTA links: The first standalone link is primary by default and later links are secondary. Keep one action per paragraph.

  • Offer: Optional split-layout row for offer copy, a heading and standalone actions associated with the media.

  • Media: Optional default-layout row containing a link to an MP4 instead of an image. If an image is supplied, it takes precedence.

  • Media description: Optional descriptive text for default-layout video. Give essential visual information an accessible text equivalent.

  • Image caption: In the default layout, text in a separate image-only cell can become a media caption.

Supported options

  • Hero Dark — heading and copy above full-width media.

  • Hero Dark (Split) — copy beside media on desktop.

  • Hero Dark (Split, Balanced) — equal desktop copy and media widths.

  • Hero Dark (Split, Inset) — extra desktop padding around split copy. Balanced and Inset require Split.

Authoring notes

  • Put each CTA link in its own paragraph. Keep links within sentences in their body paragraph. Configure tracking through Link Options when needed.

  • Use Section Metadata on the destination section for its container, background, spacing and grid. Keep those section controls separate from the block content.
